issue.title: Finish the remaining disk-retention safety and integration gaps
issue.description: Retention refuses incomplete protection evidence, preserves protected paths and Git dependencies, and reports bounded owner results on the correct filesystem.

issue.title: Share scratch liveness and report every cleanup outcome
issue.description: scratch: integrate launch-exit cleanup with the Rust scratch owner and expose ordinary-age bytes, failed removals and incomplete liveness checks.

issue.title: Refuse proc cleanup when durable protection coverage is incomplete
issue.description: procs: reject missing or malformed proc stores, preserve unreadable trees, and bound scanning while retaining reservation synchronization.

issue.title: Preserve run protections through deletion and empty-shard cleanup
issue.description: runs: fix symlink-ancestor validation, protect empty referenced runs, refresh protection coverage safely, and expose deduplicated actionable previews.

issue.title: Apply dependency-preserving repair rules to normal borrower reuse
issue.description: objects: prevent healthy checkout reuse from rewriting alternates without eligibility, source connectivity and rollback guarantees.

issue.title: Make inventory bounded and accurate about ownership and coverage
issue.description: inventory: move shared inventory classification to Rust, apply a whole-pass budget, resolve actual owned roots and configured horizons, and account for overlap and incomplete scans.

issue.title: Use owner filesystem observations and structured cleanup results
issue.description: pressure: align doctor, housekeeping and manual cleanup thresholds per filesystem and propagate owner errors, skips and measured bytes to CLI results.

issue.title: Prove the repaired combined tree and refresh host acceptance
issue.description: acceptance: run installed binding and complete verification, add regression evidence for every landing reproduction, and finish bounded inventory and build-timing acceptance.
